page_title: EVE 3-2 TOT | Everton v Tottenham Hotspur 19/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van de Ven M. Thigh Injury

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+2' 3 - 2 Richarlison (Tottenham) converts a killer cross with a strong and precise shot that goes across the goal and past the goalkeeper.
90+2' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Tottenham comes to nothing.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Substitution. Michael Keane (Everton) in, Jake O'Brien out.
81' David Moyes has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nathan Patterson (Everton) replacing Iliman Ndiaye.
80' The resulting set piece from Tottenham is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
80' Tottenham spell of possession comes to an end after a mistake. The ball goes out of play. Tottenham are awarded a corner kick.
77' 3 - 1 Goal! Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot into the top right corner. It's 3:1.
74' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Antonin Kinsky, who smothers the ball.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pape Matar Sarr trots off the pitch and is replaced by Mikey Moore (Tottenham).

73' A precise low pass is received by James Maddison (Tottenham), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
72' Richarlison (Tottenham) forces a pass into the box, but Jordan Pickford is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
70' Here's the change. Jesper Lindstrom leaves the pitch and Ashley Young (Everton) comes on as a substitute.
67' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
66' Tottenham work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

66' Djed Spence (Tottenham) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick.
65' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) tries to find Dominic Calvert-Lewin, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
63' Poor challenge! Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) is penalised for tripping and Darren England blows his whistle.
61' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) runs into space on the edge of the box and tries a curler that drifts well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
58' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Tottenham.
58' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) takes the resulting corner which is well defended. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Tottenham.
58' James Maddison (Tottenham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Tottenham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
56' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Darren England no option but to blow his whistle.
55' The number of shots on goal at present is 7:2.
49' The foul by Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) was seen by Darren England who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
48' Ben Davies (Tottenham) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
46' Ange Postecoglou has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Richarlison (Tottenham) comes on the pitch for Radu Dragusin.
46' The whistle blows and Darren England starts the second half.
45+11' The end of the first half.
45+7' 3 - 0 Archie Gray (Tottenham) deflects the ball past his own goalkeeper and into the goal after trying to jump in the way of a shot!
45+7' The corner is swung in but Everton can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45+7' A long ball forward to Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is intercepted. It will be a corner kick for Everton.
45+7' Everton have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

45+6' James Tarkowski (Everton) shows good awareness deep inside the box and jumps high to meet a perfect cross from the set piece. He steers a fine header goalwards, but finds the keeper prepared. No doubt about the wonderful save that he made. Everton force a corner. They send men into the box.
45+6' Djed Spence (Tottenham) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Darren England signals.
45+2' Radu Dragusin (Tottenham) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
45' 7 additional min. will be played.
43' Radu Dragusin (Tottenham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
42' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
40' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) was quite harsh and Darren England didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
40' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
38' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
38' Looks like Idrissa Gueye (Everton) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
37' Orel Mangala (Everton) is penalised for holding. Darren England signals a set piece.
35' The possession of the ball – 34:66.

34' Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
30' 2 - 0 Fantastic team goal! Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) was set free in the area by Idrissa Gueye and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the top of the net. 2:0.
29' Tottenham keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
28' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Heung-Min Son (Tottenham), whose effort would probably have ended inside the bottom left corner of the net.
27' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) meets an accurate cross inside the six-yard box and attempts a bullet header, but the goalkeeper denies him and makes the save.
26' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. Some classy goalkeeping by Antonin Kinsky stops the ball out of the bottom right corner.
26' Darren England blows for a foul after James Maddison (Tottenham) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
24' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Jordan Pickford is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
23' Tottenham quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
22' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
22' Tottenham are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession. The linesman makes the right call and Tottenham will have a corner.
20' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
20' Everton hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

13' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Idrissa Gueye slips the ball through to Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:0.
11' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
7' Everton can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

7' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save. The referee points to the corner flag and Everton will take a corner.
5' Tottenham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
4' Orel Mangala (Everton) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Corner kick. Everton will have an opportunity.
3' A player from Tottenham commits a rough challenge. Darren England blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
1' The match has just started.
Everton will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Darren England.
